record.body:
## Description

Show the sitting phrase, elapsed minutes, and unset count on the phase header, and size, minutes, and executor on the task title. Clipping shortens the title and keeps those suffixes.

## Approach

Read design `estimate-view`, Interfaces. The model fields from `estimate-model` are frozen: `PhaseRow.sitting`, `elapsed_minutes`, `unset_estimates`, and `TaskRow.size`, `estimate_minutes`, `executor`. Do not edit `dashboard/model.py` or `dashboard/task_detail.py`.

Edit `dashboard/tasks.py`, `tests/test_dashboard_tasks.py`, and the task-cell assertions in `tests/test_dashboard_app.py`. Do not edit the chip assertions in `test_dashboard_app.py` (`detail_chips`, `#detail-chips`).

Write the pilots first, at 60 columns, named `test_estimate_view_header_sitting`, `test_estimate_view_header_elapsed`, `test_estimate_view_header_partial`, `test_estimate_view_title_suffix`, and `test_estimate_view_clip`. Use the existing `_run(store, 60, scenario)` helper. Seed through the CLI. The phase body includes `Size: more than one sitting.` A second phase body has no `Size:` line.

1. In `section_cells`, after `{title} {done}/{total}`, append ` · {sitting}` when `sitting` is set, then ` · {n}m` when `elapsed_minutes` is not `None`, then ` · {k} unset` when `unset_estimates > 0` and `elapsed_minutes` is not `None`. Then the existing ` · awaiting sign-off`. When elapsed is `None`, append neither minutes nor the unset count. Clip only the phase title. The done/total count and the suffixes stay whole.
2. In `title_cell`, build a dim suffix in order: ` · {size}` when size is set, ` · {n}m` when `estimate_minutes` is not `None` (`0` renders `0m`), then ` · {executor}` always. Append the existing `  waits on ...` note after that suffix. Clip the title so the suffix remains in the cell plain text. The waits-on note stays after the suffix. Style the suffix and the waits-on note with `colors["muted"]`.
3. Header sitting: `more than one` is on the header, and a phase with no Size line has no sitting phrase.
4. Header elapsed: two subagent tasks in one wave with 10 and 40 show `40m`, not `50m`. An inline wave of 10 and 15 shows `25m`.
5. Header partial: two counted tasks without `estimate_minutes` and one with 25 show `25m` and `2 unset`. A phase whose counted tasks all omit `estimate_minutes` has no `m` suffix and no `unset`.
6. Title suffix: a task with size `M`, `estimate_minutes` 25, and executor `inline` shows ` · M · 25m · inline` before any waits-on note. A task with no size omits the size token. A task with `0` shows `0m`. A task with no executor shows `subagent`.
7. Clip: a long phase title still shows `more than one`, the minute token, and the unset count. A long task title still shows its suffix. The title is the part that ends with `…`.
8. Update existing task-cell assertions now that every task without an executor gains ` · subagent`. In `tests/test_dashboard_tasks.py`, `test_title_cell_clips_and_notes_what_a_waiting_task_waits_on` expects the suffix and, when the width is tight, the suffix still present while the title carries the ellipsis. In `tests/test_dashboard_app.py`, `_titles` strips the estimate suffix before comparing task identity (split on ` · `, and still strip `  waits on`). `test_waiting_row_title_ends_with_muted_waits_on_its_unfinished_dependencies` expects ` · subagent` before `  waits on`, and at 60 columns the suffix and the waits-on note stay whole. `test_running_row_status_shows_its_running_time` expects the title cell to end with ` · subagent`.

payload.title: Show estimates on the phase header and task title
